instruction: How much does my amazon cart and wishlist cost in total, ignoring potential tax and delivery fees?
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are allowed, so only read-only Amazon APIs are modeled. The plan is show passwords -> amazon.login -> amazon.show_cart -> amazon.show_wish_list -> complete_task(answer). The answer object total-cart-and-wishlist-cost is computed at runtime as the sum of product price times quantity across the cart and the wish list (ignoring tax/delivery). If a response omits per-product prices, the agent may additionally call amazon.show_product(product_id) for each item (not needed in the planning model). The static fact (is-total-cost ...) ties the complete_task answer parameter to the computed total; (found-cart-total)/(found-wishlist-total) are knowledge predicates that gate task completion.
